scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit:acceptance && npm run audit:release
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
